messages.subject: MLSEM clusters less than parameters
parts: When I run a multilevel model in lavaan that has less clusters than parameters, the model converges with no warnings. However, if I do this in mplus there is a warning about the standard errors not being trustworthy due to a non-positive definite error. I'm wondering if my findings in lavaan can be trusted?
